task: Independent review of uncommitted #2534 workload dependency security repair

issue.title: Validate workload dependencies before unscoped scheduling reads

manifest.concurrency: The additional typeIdSchema changes for cancel/retry/get/schedule IDs in workloads.ts are concurrent Code Mod Kit work; they were reviewed for interaction but are not attributed to #2534.

evidence.rpc_boundary: workloads.ts:33-56 validates dependsOn with z.array(typeIdSchema(ID_PREFIX.workload)) before forwarding. Router tests at workloads.test.ts:23-59 prove canonical pass, wrong-prefix BAD_REQUEST, and malformed BAD_REQUEST without invoking the service.
evidence.start_authority: start.ts:25-44 resolves owner from caller/mode/target. At 122-150 it validates every dependency against that resolved owner before assertAdmissible and before admit/insert; absent or foreign throws DomainNotFoundError('workload', callerSuppliedId).
evidence.retry_authority: retry.ts:43-62 validates inherited dependencies against original.ownerId after visibility/bulk authorization and before clone parameter resolution or insert; legacy cross-owner edges cannot be laundered.
evidence.shared_scope: queries.ts:47-67 uses id IN dependsOn plus owner_id = owner for owned rows or owner_id IS NULL for system rows. Admission and scheduler use this same helper.
evidence.scheduler: queries.ts:400-430 passes view.ownerId into resolveDependencyGate; a missing or foreign dependency has no scoped status and returns failed, leading to durable dependency_failed rather than dispatch.
evidence.leak_equivalence: findUnavailableWorkloadDependency returns the first caller-supplied id absent from the scoped result set. For a fixed input ID, absent and foreign take the identical DomainNotFoundError path and no row is inserted.
evidence.no_sharing_capability: Production census found no workload ACL/share table, verb, capability, or dependency-sharing producer. Non-admin lists are owner-forced; admin/system read visibility does not mint a cross-owner dependency authority.
workflow_compatibility: A non-null caller's singular row is scoped to caller.userId.
A null system caller's singular row uses its explicit ownerId; null stays the system scope.
Bulk sweep rows resolve to null owner and can depend only on null-owned rows.
Bulk create rows resolve to targetOwnerId and can depend only on that target's rows.
Admin/system retry preserves original.ownerId and validates dependencies in that same scope.
Existing scheduler tests exercise legitimate null-owned dependency chains, including waiting, success, failure, absent, and multipage cases.
attack_controls: start.int.test.ts:160-212 proves same-owner acceptance plus missing/foreign leak-free refusal without dependent persistence.
retry.int.test.ts:109-128 proves cross-owner legacy edge refusal with no clone.
queries.int.test.ts:455-470 plants a direct cross-owner edge and proves a foreign succeeded row cannot dispatch the dependent.
router workloads.test.ts:23-59 proves canonical wire validation and service non-invocation for bad IDs.

ast_grep_reads.classification: Relevant server readers are router forwarding, persistence view/gate, start, and retry; client reader is display-only. Appearance-carrier dependsOn is unrelated.

scans.rg: Corroborated all production dependsOn occurrences across workload domain/router, UI producer, portability runner, and other internal producers. Only start and retry persist workload rows; only portability DAG and UI provide dependencies.

limitations: The review did not inspect a live database for historical cross-owner rows.
Direct database writers can still plant invalid JSON, but both retry and the scheduler fail closed on absent/foreign scoped dependencies.
